title: Moss and the Rhyme Pot
note: b385 — first use of 'bench' and 'picture_card'. P3's 'split page' (log tipping in on the left, a frog on the rim on the right) is drawn as one combined picture around the same pot rather than two literal panels — a single spread reads better than a divider line for this age, and both halves of the rhyme are still clearly shown together.

pages.brief: Under the wooden garden bench, dim and cosy. Moss the berry-brown hedgehog nose-deep in a chipped terracotta pot, dry leaves all around his bedding. Dust motes in a slice of light coming under the bench.
pages.alt: Under the wooden garden bench, Moss the hedgehog leans nose-deep into a chipped terracotta pot surrounded by dry leaf bedding, a slice of light falling across the scene.

pages.brief: Moss dropping a small drawn picture-card of a cat into the pot with great ceremony. Fig the leaf-green striped caterpillar watches from the bench leg above, unconvinced, one eyebrow raised.
pages.alt: Moss drops a small picture-card of a cat into the pot with great ceremony, while Fig the caterpillar watches from above, unconvinced, one eyebrow raised.

pages.brief: In went a log. Out came a frog. Match the shapes of log and frog so the pairing is visual too.
pages.alt: A mossy log tips into the pot on one side while a startled frog sits mid-blink on the pot's rim on the other — a log went in, and a frog came out.

pages.brief: A comically enormous pale moon squeezing up out of a small flower pot, filling the top half of the page, with a wooden spoon lying discarded below. Fig with all his little legs on his hips, exasperated. Moss delighted.
pages.alt: A comically enormous pale moon squeezes up out of a small flower pot, filling the top half of the page, with a wooden spoon discarded below. Fig stands with his legs on his hips, exasperated, while Moss is delighted.

pages.brief: Fig emerging from the pot wearing a ridiculous curly grey wig several sizes too big, stripes still showing underneath. Moss laughing so hard his spikes have gone flat. Silly and warm.
pages.alt: Fig emerges from the pot wearing a ridiculous curly wig several sizes too big, his green stripes still showing underneath, while Moss laughs so hard his spikes have gone flat.

pages.brief: Wide, quiet closing scene from outside the bench looking in. Two small silhouettes side by side, the pot between them, the real moon high above the garden. Deep blues with one warm spot of light on the pot.
pages.alt: A wide, quiet closing view from outside the bench: two small friends sitting side by side with the pot between them, the real moon high above the garden in deep evening blue.
